activity_summary: You said the eleven pounds are his joy, and that you are not writing them. Nobody startles the boy. Tomorrow is three plays, and no surprise from you. The leaves stay where they are until you have seen the book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the line, and named tomorrow.

entities.name: eleven pounds
entities.context: Mentioned in Not a line in the book

facets.activity: Left John's eleven pounds out of the book

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Eleven pound of a Thursday is his joy. I am not writing it.
